attributes.action: Reject the construction of AI data centers.
attributes.additional_details:
These facilities pose unacceptable risks to our communities.
They cause strain on Power and Utility Grids: Data centres demand immense amount of electricity and water. Diverting these resources threatens local capacity, and risks increasing utility bills for hardworking residents and small businesses.

The environmental Damage: The massive carbon footprint and potential for noise pollution or local habitat destruction
attributes.background: Block plans to build AI data centers, they cause huge environmental damages and noise pollution, divert key recourses away from residents and are not worth the price.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Ban the construction of new AI data centres" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776517
